mapper.sql: M.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, M.MANAGER_SEQ as userSeq, M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_NAME as eventName, M.EVENT_EMPHASIS_YN as eventEmphasisYn, M.EVENT_DESC_IMG as eventDescImg, M.EVENT_DESC as eventDesc, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, M.START_DATE as startDate, M.END_DATE as endDate, M.STATUS as status, M.PRIVACY_POLICY_YN as privacyPolicyYn, M.PRIVACY_POLICY_TTL as privacyPolicyTtl, M.PRIVACY_POLICY_DESC as privacyPolicyDesc, M.AUTH as auth, M.AUTH_KEY_DESC as authKeyDesc, M.QR_CODE as qrCode, M.QR_CODE_IMG_PATH as qrCodeImgPath, M.QR_CODE_VISITS as qrCodeVisits, M.AUTH_CODE_URL as authCodeUrl, M.END_MESSAGE as endMessage, M.EVENT_END_IMG as eventEndImg, M.REG_DATE as regDate, M.REG_ID as regId, M.UPT_DATE as uptDate, M.UPT_ID as uptId

, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_USER U WHERE U.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') as totSurveyUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_USER U WHERE U.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ AND U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NOT NULL AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') as resSurveyUser

ORDER BY
M.START_DATE ASCDESC
M.END_DATE ASCDESC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_USER U WHERE U.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ AND U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NOT NULL) ASCDESC
M.REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY_MASTER ( MANAGER_SEQ, EVENT_CODE, EVENT_NAME, EVENT_EMPHASIS_YN, EVENT_DESC_IMG, EVENT_DESC, EVENT_TYPE, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, PRIVACY_POLICY_YN, PRIVACY_POLICY_TTL, PRIVACY_POLICY_DESC, AUTH, QR_CODE, QR_CODE_IMG_PATH, AUTH_CODE_URL, END_MESSAGE, EVENT_END_IMG, QR_CODE_VISITS, REG_DATE, REG_ID ) VALUES ( #{userSeq}, #{eventCode}, #{eventName}, #{eventEmphasisYn}, #{eventDescImg}, #{eventDesc}, #{eventType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{privacyPolicyYn}, #{privacyPolicyTtl}, #{privacyPolicyDesc}, #{auth}, #{qrCode}, #{qrCodeImgPath}, #{authCodeUrl}, #{endMessage}, #{eventEndImg}, IFNULL(#{qrCodeVisits}, 0), NOW(), #{regId} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE SURVEY_MASTER SET EVENT_NAME = #{eventName}, EVENT_EMPHASIS_YN = #{eventEmphasisYn}, EVENT_TYPE = #{eventType}, EVENT_DESC = #{eventDesc}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, STATUS = #{status}, PRIVACY_POLICY_YN = #{privacyPolicyYn},
PRIVACY_POLICY_TTL = #{privacyPolicyTtl}, PRIVACY_POLICY_DESC = #{privacyPolicyDesc},
AUTH = #{auth}, QR_CODE = #{qrCode},
QR_CODE_IMG_PATH = #{qrCodeImgPath}, AUTH_CODE_URL = #{authCodeUrl},
EVENT_DESC_IMG = #{eventDescImg},
END_MESSAGE = #{endMessage},
EVENT_END_IMG = #{eventEndImg},
UPT_ID = #{uptId}, UPT_DATE = NOW() WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq}
UPDATE SURVEY_MASTER SET STATUS = 'F' WHERE STATUS != 'F' AND END_DATE < NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT EVENT_NAME FROM SURVEY_MASTER WHERE 1=1
AND REG_ID = #{regId}
AND EVENT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY EVENT_NAME LIMIT 10
